name: Choose a guest, student or teacher entry route
description: Verifies the welcome screen offers three access routes and guests cannot enter private tests or teacher management.
steps: Open the app while signed out
Choose Use without logging in
Open Learning library
Attempt to open Skill practice
Return to the welcome screen and inspect student and teacher sign-in choices
expected: Guest access exposes public learning resources only; private skill practice and tests require sign-in; teacher management is not exposed to students or guests.

name: Save a student's cohort after account sign-in
covers: Google and email account sign-in options
description: Verifies a newly authenticated student must select one of the supported cohorts before entering the learning workspace.
steps: Sign in or create an account as a student
Choose Cohort IV in the required cohort step
Continue to the student learning space
Refresh the app
expected: The selected cohort is saved to the signed-in student profile and the student enters the learner workspace without being asked again.

name: Keep the teacher workspace separate and assign learning material
covers: teacher cannot take student tests or use student materials
description: Verifies only the authorised teacher sees management tools and can publish a cohort-specific HTTPS resource assignment.
steps: Sign in with the authorised teacher account
Confirm only the management portal is available
Create a material assignment with title, HTTPS link, description and Cohort II
Open student test and lesson routes directly
expected: The teacher can create a Cohort II assignment and manage learner progress; student tests, student lesson navigation and the student resource library are unavailable to the teacher.

name: Open a lesson video and complete scored practice
covers: YouTube-first DET resource collection across all four skills
official DET handbook, sample questions, test structure and scoring links
Arno practice platform and Arno video walkthroughs
Quill grammar, proofreading, sentence construction and reading evidence resources
YouTube official and independent DET tutorials
College Board SAT Reading and Writing, Bluebook and Student Question Bank resources
description: Verifies the learner-facing library presents an embedded instructional video followed by active practice and feedback.
steps: Sign in as a student and complete cohort onboarding
Open Learning library
Play the embedded lesson video
Open Skill practice and complete a task
Open Mock test and grant browser camera permission
Begin the mock and confirm the live camera preview appears
Switch away from the test tab or exit full-screen mode
Acknowledge the warning and continue answering
expected: The official DET walkthrough is embedded in the learning flow; the library offers a broad collection of task-specific YouTube tutorials, full courses, mock tests and general English development videos; a completed skill task produces a numerical score with feedback and a next-step recommendation. The mock test displays a live camera preview, warns when the test loses focus or full-screen mode, and continues without cancelling the practice session.

name: Maintain private student records and cohort-scoped assignments
description: Verifies profile and assignment records are scoped to the authenticated learner and existing assessment milestones remain available only to students.
steps: Sign in as Student A and select Cohort I
Open the assigned materials area
Sign in as Student B in a separate session and select Cohort VII
Open the assigned materials area
Attempt to call the teacher assignment endpoint as a student
expected: Students receive only assignments for their own cohort; Student A cannot read Student B's profile or progress; students cannot create assignments; the baseline, midline and endline assessment journey remains intact.

name: Teacher opens and exits read-only student preview
covers: read-only preview banner and return control
preview cannot submit tests or save student scores
teacher role and management permissions remain intact
description: Verifies the authorised teacher can inspect the student-facing layout without changing account role or creating learner activity.
steps: Sign in with the authorised teacher account
Open the teacher management portal
Select View as a student
Inspect the student home page and learning library
Attempt to open a test or submit practice
Select Return to teacher portal
expected: The learner-facing experience opens in read-only preview mode; test and practice submissions are blocked; returning restores the teacher management portal and permissions.
